description.describe_ch: 本課程分四級授課，採用多元教學活動，協助學生運用語言學習策略，討論教材之議題，以深化英語閱讀、口說、與聽力的技能，並學習理解他人觀點及感受。
description.describe_eh: The course is divided into four levels and uses a variety of teaching activities to help students apply language learning strategies, discuss topics from their course materials, deepen their English reading, speaking, and listening skills, and learn to understand the different viewpoints and feelings of others..

targets.describe_ch: 運用所學之學習策略，針對教材內容，有效地以外語表達自我想法，與他人進行溝通。
targets.describe_en: Students can apply learning strategies to effectively convey their opinions regarding the themes presented in learning materials and communicate with others effectively.

targets.describe_ch: 藉由合作式學習，了解、尊重多元觀點。
targets.describe_en: Through collaborative learning, students can understand and respect diverse perspectives.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
*學生應準時出席上課。如果您的上課時間，無法按時到課，請不要選課。 除非您生病或有緊急情況，否則應在上課前，要準時到達教室，並坐在位子上。如果您有某種原因必須提早下課，請提前告知我。
*所有學生在課堂上都應尊重每個人，並且在任何時候都應以合理、負責和禮貌的態度行事。
*上課時請勿講話、閱讀、睡覺或做其他非本課程相關作業，除分組進行討論外，否則應盡量減少邊際對話。如果您正坐在一個可能在上課時和您聊天的人旁邊，請移到另一個座位，以免您屈服於誘惑。
*當同學簡報或提問時，您應該專心地聆聽。當您簡報時，您應該面對自己的小組或全班同學大聲說話，讓同學能聽清楚。
*允許使用筆記型電腦或平板等載具，進行課堂記筆記，否則應將其收起。
*要確保在上課時，關閉手機、PDA等移動設備，並收起及保持靜音。
* 上課請帶課本，課文和習題會在課堂上做練習。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Behavior in the classroom should always be prompt, professional, prepared, and courteous. Effective learning can only be achieved by maintaining mutual dignity and mutual respect among classmates, teachers or other lecturers. In order to ensure a conducive learning environment, everyone is expected to do the following, abide by each other's classroom behavior rules, and get used to a culture of politeness.
Students should attend class on time. If you cannot arrive at the class on time due to your class time, please do not register for the class. Unless you are sick or there is an emergency, you should be in your classroom on time and in your seat before class starts. If you have to leave class early for any reason, please let me know in advance.
All students are expected to treat everyone with respect in the classroom and to behave reasonably, responsibly, and courteously at all times.
Do not talk, read, sleep or do other non-course-related homework during class, except for group discussions, otherwise marginal conversations should be minimized. If you are sitting next to someone who might be chatting with you during class, move to another seat so you don't give in to temptation.
You should listen attentively when classmates present or ask questions. When you present, you should speak loudly to your group or class so that they can hear you clearly.
Laptops or tablets are allowed to take notes in class, otherwise they should be put away.
Make sure that mobile devices such as mobile phones and PDAs are turned off during class, and put away and keep silent.
Students are not allowed to wear earphones in class.
Dress neatly without revealing.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
* 缺課12節以上含12節及請假，期中考、期末考和口頭報告有缺一個以上，學期總成績一率不及格。
* 遲交作業將不予計分(Any overdue assignment will not be accepted.)
* 缺考學生如未請假，則當缺考零分計算。缺考學生如於考試當天起3天內向任課教師請假，經教師簽名同意後送外語中心始得申請補考，但非重大事故補考，成績會打八折。
* 請尊重智慧財產權，購買原文書。
* 請益時間的時段會公佈在iLearn上，請您提前預約以防止有其他學生與事務的預定。
* 如果您有任何疑問或問題，您可以運用學校Office365電子郵件或是iLearn與我聯繫。(fyliao@o365.fcu.edu.tw)
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
在專題報告，觀察及審閱同學彼此的學習任務，鼓勵與同學合作，以完成書面報告、或專題實作。組成學習或閱讀小組可能是學習的有效途徑。但是，當您撰寫文章或論文時，文字必須是您自己的。
  • 您必須認真遵守用於確認語詞和想法來源的標準規則。如果您使用了短語或引語，或者是另一位作者的用語或想法，則必須確認這些用語或想法的來源，並在報告中標註這些素材的出處。作者的姓名和在句子末尾，包含使用原材料的頁碼。
  • 如果抄襲或以其他方式來掩蔽您的作品來源，您的作業將為零分。若屢次不改，將依學生獎懲辦法提送獎懲委員會處分。
  • 如果您作作業感到惶恐，請不要試圖作抄襲或作弊。可以與我聯繫，我們可以協商找出可幫助您完成學業的方案
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Learning must be based on honesty. Any student who attempts to use a work that he has not produced as his own is considered dishonest. Students who cheat or plagiarize in homework, tests or exams, or assist others, will be scored as zero. If they are repeat offenders, they will be submitted in accordance with the rewards and punishments for students of Feng Chia University.
  • It is considered cheating if you copy someone else's answers during an assessment, or if you turn in a paper or assignment that was written in whole or in part by someone else when you turned in an assignment.

  • It is considered cheating if you copy someone else's answers during an assessment, or if you turn in a paper or assignment that was written in whole or in part by someone else when you turned in an assignment.
